# loop-improver-mcp insight

## 2026-08-09T19:12:16.805Z - Tree audit adds a deploy-blocking output contract
**Mission:** loop architecture improvement
**Improved:** Completed the tree audit in two coherent batches. First, removed 64 stale or generated tracked files totaling 6.52 MB: legacy All Aboard audit output, two obsolete unreferenced image generations, one unused public image, and a nested astro-site/.github control plane. Second, added a dependency-free Node smoke suite for six critical generated outputs, homepage and article social metadata, and RSS identity. Added npm test and npm run check, switched both GitHub workflows to the shared build-plus-test command, and updated repository verification guidance. npm run check generated 49 pages and passed 9 tests; git diff --check and editor diagnostics passed; independent cleanup and evidence reviews approved the result.
**Prune candidates:** Two empty untracked local directories remain outside the approved scope: astro-site/presentations/templates/_unzipped and astro-site/public/assets/favicon-concepts. Do not remove them without user approval because Git cannot restore untracked local contents. WalkingDeck.astro remains a 5,319-line behavior-sensitive refactor candidate that needs a separate design and visual validation pass.
**Reusable learnings:** Generated visual audits belong under ignored astro-site/.artifacts paths. Nested .github trees need a documented scoped purpose or they become competing control planes. Public images need an active source reference or explicit retention note. A static-site build is stronger when critical routes and generated metadata are asserted after generation. Use an explicit test file path when the suite has one file so a missing file fails and shell glob behavior cannot differ across Windows and Linux. Keep the prior distribution lesson: canonical and social metadata close a high-value discovery gap after navigation, archive, and RSS exist.
**Agent self-improvement:** Combine tracked-size, reference, ownership, and regeneration evidence before deletion. Separate low-risk cleanup from behavior refactors. For validation work, write the smallest output-level test, run it before wiring CI, let failures refine the real contract, then use one shared local and workflow command. Request independent review for CI bypasses and portability risks before recording completion.

## 2026-08-09T20:10:06.046Z - Runtime graphics need state choreography, not ambient motion
**Mission:** visual system improvement
**Improved:** Rebuilt the enterprise AI runtime-control figure as a data-driven Astro component with a four-stage authority sequence, a Level 1 branch, coordinated active and passed states, responsive layouts, and the Walking Deck signal palette. Added a viewport-entry bootstrap with an IntersectionObserver and geometry fallback, while leaving the complete static figure visible for reduced motion and failed JavaScript. Corrected the Walking Deck signal-impact portrait from a 152 by 85.5 pixel landscape crop to a true 4:5 treatment at about 141 by 176 pixels in present mode. The dedicated present route now honors section hashes, so `#signal-impact` opens directly on Section 04. The final build emitted 50 pages, all 9 output tests passed, the edited source files had no diagnostics, and laptop/mobile checks showed no horizontal overflow.
**Reusable learnings:** The Walking Deck impact comes from coordinated state replacement: node, rail, branch, status, and evidence should change as one authored beat. Start article motion when the figure enters the reading viewport. Keep the no-JavaScript frame complete, and make reduced motion skip initialization instead of hiding content. Match source-image geometry to its role; forcing a portrait into a compact 16:9 slot can make an important image read like a thumbnail.
**Agent self-improvement:** Prove client execution separately from viewport entry. A loaded module does not prove that an observer callback fired, and automated instant scrolling may change geometry without dispatching a native scroll event. Use a direct geometry read and explicit event dispatch when validating viewport behavior, then sample named states over time instead of judging motion from one still frame.
